sources.title: Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B model card
sources.evidence: Exact model: nominal 30B total and 3B activated, thinking/instruct modes, 1M context claim, tool deployment, explicit March 19, 2026 release date and NVIDIA Open Model License link. July 9 parser update is present.

sources.title: Nemotron-Cascade 2 technical report, revision 2
sources.evidence: Latest listed revision (March 22, 2026): 30B/3B nominal model, Cascade RL and multi-domain on-policy distillation. Introduction states 1M context; Appendix A.5 evaluates NIAH/RULER with 1M-token context. Text reasoning, coding and tool-use training/evaluation are described.

sources.title: Nemotron-Cascade 2 submission history
sources.evidence: First submitted March 19, 2026; revision 2 submitted March 22, 2026. Exact model release link accompanies the report.

sources.title: Nemotron-Cascade 2 research announcement
sources.evidence: Names the exact 30B-A3B model and NVIDIA authors, links weights, and describes Cascade RL/distillation. Page is dated March 16, 2026, conflicting with the model card’s explicit March 19 release date; this page date is not silently substituted for weight release.

sources.title: Exact Cascade 2 checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: NemotronHForCausalLM; 52 blocks (23 Mamba, 23 MoE, 6 attention); hidden width 2688; vocabulary 131072; untied embeddings. Top-6 of 128 routed experts, shared expert width 3712, routed width 1856. Configuration default maximum is 262144 tokens.

sources.title: Exact Cascade 2 model implementation
sources.evidence: Defines Mamba-2 mixers, attention and ReLU2 two-matrix expert MLPs. A_log, D and dt_bias are learned parameters; router e_score_correction_bias is explicitly a registered buffer. Native model contains no MTP module.

sources.title: Cascade 2 configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Maps M/*/E symbols to Mamba/attention/MoE blocks; identifies the dimensions and default bias behavior used to independently reconstruct indexed shapes.

sources.title: Cascade 2 BF16 checkpoint index and bounded shard headers
sources.evidence: All 13 indexed shards read by bounded HTTP 206 ranges for their eight-byte prefixes and JSON headers only. All 6243 names/shapes/offsets match independently reconstructed code/config tensors. 6220 learned BF16 tensors contain 31577937344 parameters; 23 FP32 routing buffers contain 2944 excluded elements. Index metadata matches learned count and 63155886464 payload bytes.

sources.title: Cascade 2 chat template
sources.evidence: Text messages, enable_thinking control, structured function schemas/calls and wrapped tool responses are implemented. Tool handling is supported despite rendering responses inside user turns.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement

patch.description: Text model combining Mamba-2, attention and sparse MoE layers, post-trained with Cascade RL and multi-domain on-policy distillation for reasoning and tool use.

sources.label: Cascade 2 BF16 checkpoint index and bounded shard headers

patch.notes: Total is an independently reconstructed complete learned BF16 checkpoint count (31.577937344B), excluding 23 routing buffers; active 3B remains the developer’s nominal exact-model claim. Context is the advertised nominal 1M maximum; checkpoint config and example serving commands use 262144. The technical report evaluates this exact model at 1M. March 19 is the explicit model-card release date; NVIDIA’s research page bears a March 16 publication date.

checkpoint_reconstruction.method: Build every expected tensor name and shape independently from exact config and implementation, then compare every indexed tensor with freshly fetched bounded shard JSON headers. Validate HTTP 206 Content-Range, exact read length, dtype, contiguous byte offsets, file size, index membership and metadata totals. No weight payload is fetched.

shape_derivation.common: D=2688, V=131072; independent input/output [V,D]; each block norm [D], final norm [D].
shape_derivation.mamba: I=64*64=4096; C=I+2*8*128=6144. Each of 23 mixers: in_proj [I+C+64,D], out_proj [D,I], conv [C,1,4] and bias [C], mixer norm [I], A_log/D/dt_bias each [64].
shape_derivation.attention: Each of 6 attention mixers: q/o matrices [4096,2688]/[2688,4096]; k/v each [256,2688]; no biases.
shape_derivation.moe: Each of 23 MoE mixers: router [128,2688]; 128 experts each up [1856,2688] and down [2688,1856]; shared expert up [3712,2688] and down [2688,3712]. Exclude router correction buffer [128].

checkpoint_reconstruction.active_crosscheck_note: Subtracting 122 unselected routed experts per MoE layer from full learned inventory leaves 3580073408 elements including both full embedding matrices, or 3227751872 excluding input embedding. These are explicitly scoped structural inventories, not a documented exact active-count convention. Published exact Cascade figure remains nominal 3B.

summary: Verified all 14 fields against exact Cascade 2 primary sources. Correct total to 31.577937344B from complete independently reconstructed BF16 headers, architecture to hybrid SSM/Transformer/MoE, license and nominal 1M context; retain published nominal 3B active. Record 262144 config/example versus 1M supported-context distinction and March16 research-page versus explicit March19 model-release date.
